svg.title: Bus driver — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as bus driver, wearing a work uniform. Visible work cue: A tall front-view bus has a broad windscreen, two low headlights and two short visible tyres. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face.
